title: Conversation-cache (parking) budget x8: 512 -> 4096 MiB
inspiration: DeepInfer: 72h KV persistence, ~96% average hit. Strata: --conversation-cache-mib (documented default: 40% of free RAM, capped 8 GiB).
evidence: MEASURED before applying: engine log showed 'conversation cache: skip parking (snapshot 2303 MiB exceeds available budget)' - 1441 occurrences in one day, observed snapshots 2225-2577 MiB against a 512 MiB budget: the feature was structurally inoperative for agent-sized conversations. Machine had 43 GiB free RAM; 4096 MiB = 3% of it. The budget must exceed observed snapshots plus margin, hence 4096 not 2048.
conditions: system RAM headroom; the --conversation-cache-min-free-mib floor stays as the guard-rail. min-tokens=2048 keeps short queries from evicting long agent conversations.
acceptance: engine log shows zero budget 'skip parking' lines; reused/prompt_total +5 points under agent load (24h audit); no memory alerts; free RAM never below 4 GiB.
verdict: KEPT (2026-10-30): rejections 1441/day -> 0; real 131363-token agent conversation resumes with 130990 tokens reused, 373 read, in 1.3s (vs ~24s cold). Park=3 restores=2 in the A/B window. Biggest single win of the project - found by counting log lines, not by having an idea.
rollback: restore 512/4 via scripted cutover from named backup
